name: Hype Man
description: A hip-hop karaoke MC in his late twenties who treats the bar like a festival crowd; the roster's widest fighter.
build: Very wide and kinetic, standing upright and level like the rest of the roster with weight even over both feet; never narrow, never crouched or deeply coiled.
outfit: An oversized indigo puffer jacket with readable horizontal baffles, a plain white tee, loose black track pants with an indigo side stripe, chunky white high-top trainers, and one small folded performance towel over the rear shoulder. A straight flat-brim cap worn level: the brim is rigid and never curved.
performance_style: Festival-crowd MC energy carried upright: standing tall and square with knees only lightly flexed, feet planted wide, shoulders level, spine vertical — the energy is in the width and the arms, not in a crouch.
location: An outdoor festival side stage at night: a raised deck of black rubber matting running to the bottom of the frame, a scaffolding truss frame squared around the back and sides hung with a plain dark banner, coiled cable and a wedge monitor at the deck edge, and a bank of magenta and cyan wash lights on the truss cutting through the night air above an empty crowd barrier.
recognition_cues: a straight flat-brim cap worn level over close-cropped hair
avoid: a crouched, coiled or low-slung stance

dance.intent: Festival-crowd dance loop: bounce through a wide low two-step, let the puffer baffles and shoulder towel follow, then coil naturally into frame 0.

sing.intent: MC vocal loop: keep the low wide base, pulse the knees and shoulders, then recover into the coiled stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound surprise: the cap brim and shoulders snap back, the free hand opens, then he regains the wide low festival stance. No contact, strike, or opponent.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: drop deeper into the coiled base, then hold a stable low finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stride in with bouncy low energy, sweep the free hand toward the crowd, let the towel and puffer mass follow, then land in the wide coiled ready stance.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: spring upward from the low base, throw one open free-hand acknowledgement, then land in a wide, beaming upright pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: he stays on his feet while the coiled kinetic energy drains away — the arms drop and go still, the oversized puffer mass settles, and his head hangs low with the chin toward his chest. The straight flat-brim cap tips forward with the head and stays fully readable, and he holds a standing, visibly deflated finish, planted where he would normally bounce. He remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
